The word अदस् 'that' is called गति when in composition with a verb and not implying a direction to another.

Terms: गति-अच्छ
The word जग्धि is the substitute of अद् 'to eat', when the affix ल्यप् -- समासेऽनञ्पूर्वे क्त्वो ल्यप्‌

or an आर्धधातुक कित् affix beginning with a त follows.

Terms: आर्धधातुक-substitutes

The affix विट् comes after the verb अद् 'to eat' when in composition with a case-inflected word other than अन्न 'food'.

Terms: विट्
